name.description: Kebab-case name of the reusable field component. Required unless --document is given; defaults to the node [name] attribute or id.

path.description: Destination directory within the application source tree. Defaults to src/app/shared/form-helpers.

project.description: Angular application project. Required when the workspace has multiple application source roots.

kind.description: Native control kind. Supported kinds are text, email, password, and textarea; every kind has a string value model. Defaults to text. Not allowed with --document.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a TextInputs node; [type], [appearance], and [subscriptSizing] come from the node.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first element of a supported type. Requires --document.
